reason: I've got a drawer full of lip stuff I wore once, and I've been burned by online offers before. A brand-new balm with zero reviews at $36, pushed through a Facebook ad, is exactly the kind of thing I scroll past now.
objection: No reviews and I've never heard of them. A 365-day guarantee sounds great, but I've chased refunds before and I don't believe it'll be easy until someone I trust says it was.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from women my age saying it didn't dry or bleed, and someone confirming they actually got their refund without a fight.
